checks: Audio stays dormant before a gesture, then the actual Watch click unlocks native audio with measurable output
Native synthesized loosen/tighten, lift/lower, wheel off/on and release cues all produce nonzero output
Mute stops current sources and blocks new task sounds; native output at zero master volume is silent
Free Space pauses/resumes the replay; held-key repeat does not repeatedly toggle playback
Focused Restart, speed, Event Log and Close replay buttons retain native Space activation; Escape closes only the Event Log first
scope: Actual React App/ReplayView controls and native Chromium Web Audio. A completed 21-event TypeScript-engine round is supplied through a local API fixture. WebGL disabled to isolate controls/audio. Measured digital output proves synthesis and mute behavior; physical speaker audibility, Safari autoplay and hosted Supabase are not tested here.
